answer_1.quote: we present a framework that jointly generates speech and text output by combining S2ST and S2T tasks through a shared encoder ...

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the translation quality, we follow the setup ... compute BLEU using SACREBLEU. ... We also measure character error rate (CER) for text output.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human listening tests to collect mean opinion scores (MOS) to evaluate the naturalness of the speech output. We randomly sample 200 utterances ... each sample is rated by 8 raters on a scale of 1-5.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate the naturalness of the generated speech on a 1‑5 Likert scale.
